message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run tests

on: [ push, pull_request ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        version: [ '1.18', '1.19', '1.20', '1.21', '1.22', '1.23', '1.24', '1.25', '1.26' ]
        platform: [ ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest ]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
    - name: Install Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.version }}
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
    - name: Build
      run: go build -v ./...
    - name: Test
      run: go test -v -race ./...",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go CI matrix (9 Go versions x 3 platforms) with no dependency cache, so every job re-fetches modules on each run. The repository has go.mod/go.sum, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions (repeated dependency fetching; lockfile available as cache input). The matching measured experiment (Go module cache added after checkout, before build/test) reported elapsed savings with no coverage loss. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed by go.mod/go.sum preserves all build/test steps and matrix coverage, adds no secrets, privileged actions, deployment, or new network access, and does not weaken the existing contents: read permission. Contraindications are not triggered: no equivalent cache exists and the cached module content is not mutable/untrusted.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
